description: Dependency PRs for everything except pub. Pub is excluded: Renovate's pub manager expects a pubspec.lock beside each pubspec.yaml and does not support pub workspaces, whose one lock sits at the root (renovatebot/renovate#40361, closed as not planned). .github/workflows/roll.yml upgrades pub dependencies instead (`dart pub upgrade --major-versions`).

packageRules.description: Flutter moves only with its artifacts (web SDK, AERA kits, Dart Android kits): the PR is the signal to cut them, and pins follow once they are published.
Actions are pinned by full SHA with a version comment; group their updates.
